Intersect coast-masked approximate OSW state polygons and NASA's 70 published equirectangular crop rectangles in the same display projection, allowing 360-degree horizontal wraps. Exclude contacts covering at most 0.001% of a state's display area. Rank each state's regional crops by display overlap at the highest zoom with any overlap. The overview is the level-1 crop with greatest display overlap, or level 0 if unavailable.

geometries.method: Approximate offshore point near the 1–5 nautical mile Torungen stations used to characterize the Norwegian Coastal Current; derived from the mapped Store Torungen reference, not a published station coordinate or whole-current footprint.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: A source identifies the current along the Norwegian coast and represents it with stations 1 and 5 nautical miles off Torungen; this is a section location, not a whole-current length. Its relation to the name Norwegian Current is convention-dependent.
